name: Soak
description: Soak slows movement by 0.03 turn and reduces hit chance by 1 per stack. Each stack lowers electricity resistance by 2 and frost resistance by 1. Lasts 6 turns unless refreshed. Hydromancy hits wring off dripping Wet into Soak. Stack count is wetness depth, not duration — 1 stack is light damp; more stacks are heavier soak.

name: Hydraulic Laceration
description: High-pressure water cuts deep, causing bleed per stack.
